text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I bump into Symboli Rudolf in front of<n>the school
gates. She seems to be on<n>her way out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. What an unexpected<n>surprise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am. I was going to indulge in some...<n>social
studies, I suppose you might<n>call them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You can accompany me, if you'd like.<n>Assuming
you have no other<n>obligations.

With no other plans for the day, I<n>decide to go with
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The two of us eventually arrive at the<n>racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, let's see... What is on the<n>schedule today...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, not today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse hosts all manner of<n>events in
addition to races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They present good opportunities to<n>gain insight
into the general public's<n>perception of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I like to drop in and<n>take a look
when I have the time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as this is your first time, why<n>don't you
select the event?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf gestures to a<n>noticeboard covered
in posters for<n>various events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Select whichever strikes your fancy<n>and we'll go
together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Two activities in particular stand out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Cleaning up the stands, hm? I'll lead<n>the way.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Volunteers of all ages and<n>backgrounds have
come to join the<n>garbage cleanup.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hello there! Aren't you the Tracen<n>Academy
student council president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am. It's a pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the pleasure's all mine! It's such<n>a joy to
watch you all on the track.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I come along to these cleanups as my<n>own little
way of giving back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That's very humbling to<n>hear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf takes the opportunity<n>to speak with
a variety of other<n>volunteers as we work.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them harbors clear<n>affection for the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems to take<n>pleasure in listening
to what everyone<n>has to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for indulging me today.
choice_data_list: Not at all. I learned a lot.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear that. I feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I learned an important lesson today:<n>our fans
support us in various ways,<n>even when we aren't
racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The next time I look out into the<n>stands, it will be
with a different<n>sense of appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the day draws to a close, I feel<n>that I've gotten
a rare glimpse of<n>what Symboli Rudolf values.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? A limited-time exhibition of<n>Umamusume
achievements... And as<n>luck would have it, it
opens today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Surely this will be worth seeing. Shall<n>we take a
look?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Entering the venue, it's clear at a<n>glance that the
organizers have<n>spared no effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... They've collated the<n>achievements of
famed Umamusume<n>all around the world, not just
in races,<n>but in the culture surrounding racing<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame this exhibition is only<n>temporary. The
organizers' passion<n>for Umamusume is plain to
see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do wish it was better promoted,<n>though. Perhaps
there's something<n>we could do to help...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though subtle, there's a spark of joy<n>in her eyes
as she surveys the<n>exhibit.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy all it has to offer, with<n>Symboli Rudolf
occasionally chiming in<n>as my personal guide.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My, it has gotten late. Still, that was<n>an afternoon
well spent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's important to remember that races<n>are more
than just contests of skill.<n>They're part of
Umamusume history<n>and culture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They form a great river of time and<n>devotion,
flowing all the way from the<n>distant past to the
present we and our<n>fans inhabit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll see what I can do to have this<n>exhibition
advertised around the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you for indulging me today.
choice_data_list: Not at all. I learned a lot.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the day draws to a close, I feel<n>that I've gotten
a rare glimpse of<n>Symboli Rudolf's love for
knowledge.
